complaint: My flight AB-302 from Bengaluru to Mumbai was delayed by three hours because of a "technical snag." We were kept sitting inside the aircraft without AC for 45 minutes in this heat. Absolute torture for elderly passengers. I want a full refund for this harassment.

What is the point of charging premium fares if your flights are never on time? AB-114 from Delhi to Patna was delayed by 5 hours today. No food coupons were given, and the ground staff at IGI T3 was extremely rude when we asked for updates. Worst experience ever.

My parents were traveling from Kolkata to Guwahati on flight AB-882. It got delayed by 6 hours due to weather, which is understandable, but your team did not even provide them with a bottle of water or a place to sit. They are diabetic and had to suffer so much.

Extremely disappointed with ACME Bharat. Flight AB-405 from Pune to Delhi was pushed back four times, and finally, at midnight, they cancelled it. I had to book a last-minute ticket on another airline for Rs 12,000 to attend my job interview. Who will compensate me for this loss?

My connecting flight from Chennai to Port Blair via Kolkata was ruined because the first leg was delayed by two hours. Your staff told me they would hold the connection, but they didn't. Now I am stuck in Kolkata airport with two small kids. Please arrange a hotel immediately!

Flight AB-512 from Hyderabad to Goa got delayed by four hours. First you said operational reasons, then you said incoming aircraft delay. Why lie to passengers? Just tell the truth. Our entire day of vacation in Goa is wasted because of your poor management.

Total chaos at Mumbai airport today. ACME Bharat flight AB-701 to Kochi was delayed overnight. They promised hotel accommodation but made us wait in the lobby for three hours before saying no rooms are available. Ground staff simply disappeared. This is highly unprofessional.

My flight from Lucknow to Delhi is delayed by 3 hours. I am going to miss my international flight to London because of this. Your customer care is not responding, and the desk staff here says they cannot do anything. My career is at stake, please help me.

I have been flying with ACME Bharat for three years, but today’s experience on AB-209 from Ahmedabad to Jaipur was pathetic. A 50-minute flight was delayed by 4 hours. No announcements were made. We were just left guessing at the boarding gate. Very poor communication.

They boarded us on the plane for flight AB-663 from Srinagar to Delhi, and then we sat on the tarmac for two hours. They said there is air traffic congestion, but other airlines were taking off. The cabin crew refused to serve even water during this time. Shocking behavior.

My flight AB-182 from Amritsar to Delhi got delayed by 5 hours due to fog, which I understand. But why was there no updates on the SMS? I reached the airport at 4 AM freezing in the cold, only to find out the flight will depart at 10 AM. You must improve your notification system.

ACME Bharat is a joke. Flight AB-903 from Bangalore to Ranchi was delayed by 3 hours, and when it finally took off, they did not even serve the pre-booked meals we paid for, saying they ran out of stock due to the delay. I want my money back for the food and the delay.

I missed my brother's wedding ceremony in Udaipur because flight AB-334 from Mumbai was delayed by over six hours due to some technical issue with the engine. You ruined a once-in-a-lifetime family event for me. I am going to file a case in the consumer forum.

The flight from Bhubaneswar to Kolkata (AB-721) was delayed by 90 minutes, making me miss my train to Siliguri from Howrah station. I had to take a private cab which cost me Rs 6000. ACME Bharat must compensate me for this heavy financial loss.

My flight AB-154 from Guwahati to Delhi got delayed, and then we were diverted to Jaipur because of bad weather. We have been sitting inside the plane at Jaipur airport for the last three hours. No food, no updates. The toilets are stinking now. Please let us out!

Why do you operate flights if you cannot maintain your aircraft? Flight AB-808 from Varanasi to Mumbai was delayed by seven hours because of "operational reasons" which actually means you didn't have a standby aircraft. My business meeting is cancelled. Horrible service.

My 75-year-old grandmother was traveling alone from Coimbatore to Chennai on AB-441. The flight was delayed by 4 hours. Despite booking wheelchair assistance, no one helped her during the delay period. She had to manage everything on her own. This is highly insensitive.

Flight AB-922 from Dehradun to Delhi got delayed by 3 hours. When I asked for a refund or reschedule, the counter executive behaved very rudely and told me to read the terms and conditions. Is this how you treat your premium club members? I will never fly with you again.

My flight from Jammu to Srinagar was delayed for 5 hours. We were made to sit in the security hold area without any heating in this freezing weather. No tea or coffee was offered by ACME Bharat staff. You people have no basic humanity or customer service empathy.

Our flight AB-305 from Delhi to Bagdogra was delayed by 4 hours, and then we were told the crew had exceeded their duty hours, so a new crew is coming. Why was this not planned earlier? Now our entire prepaid taxi and hotel booking in Darjeeling is gone to waste.

I had booked a flight from Mumbai to Delhi for my sister's wedding, but ACME Bharat cancelled it at the last minute citing "operational reasons." No alternative flight was offered, and now last-minute tickets on other airlines are costing me Rs 15,000. This is absolute harassment. I demand a full refund and compensation for the mental agony.

My flight from Bengaluru to Kolkata was cancelled due to bad weather. I understand safety comes first, but your ground staff at KIA was extremely rude and refused to provide even water or food vouchers while we waited for 6 hours to get clarity. At least show some basic humanity to stranded passengers.

I had to cancel my tickets from Pune to Nagpur because of a medical emergency in my family. I uploaded all the doctor's certificates on your portal, but your system is still showing a zero refund after deducting heavy cancellation charges. This is highly unfair and insensitive. Please look into this.

Absolutely pathetic service! Flight AB-402 from Chennai to Coimbatore was cancelled just 2 hours before departure. No SMS, no email was sent to me. I reached the airport with my elderly parents only to find the counter closed. How can you be so irresponsible? I want my money back immediately.

My flight from Srinagar to Delhi got cancelled due to heavy snowfall. While other airlines are adjusting their passengers on next day flights for free, ACME Bharat is asking me to pay a fare difference of Rs 5000 to rebook. Why should I pay extra for a natural weather event? This is daylight robbery.

I cancelled my booking from Hyderabad to Goa well outside the 24-hour window, but your app has charged me the full amount as cancellation fees. I tried calling your customer care helpline multiple times but it keeps getting disconnected. Is anyone even working there? Refund my money!

My son was traveling from Kochi to Mumbai today. Your airline cancelled the flight when he was already at the gate. No accommodation was provided, and a 19-year-old student was left to fend for himself at the airport at midnight. This is highly unsafe. I am going to file a complaint with DGCA.

Extremely disappointed with ACME Bharat. I cancelled my tickets from Patna to Delhi five days ago due to a sudden change in my exam dates. Your website promised that the refund would be credited within 48 hours, but it has been 120 hours and I have received nothing. Please update the status.

Our family vacation to Port Blair from Kolkata was ruined because ACME Bharat decided to cancel the flight citing technical issues. They did not even arrange a hotel for us. My kids had to sleep on the airport chairs. We spent Rs 40,000 on hotel bookings in Havelock which are now completely wasted. Who will pay for this loss?

I made a mistake in the booking dates for my flight from Ahmedabad to Jaipur and tried to cancel it within 10 minutes of booking. According to DGCA rules, there should be no cancellation charge within 24 hours of booking, but your system deducted Rs 3000. Kindly reverse this illegal charge.

My flight AB-112 from Guwahati to Delhi got cancelled today. Your ground staff is telling me that they can only refund the base fare and not the taxes and fuel surcharge. This is ridiculous! The cancellation was from your side, not mine. I want a 100% refund of the total amount paid.

Terrible experience at Lucknow airport. Our flight to Mumbai was cancelled due to sudden fog, which is understandable. But the complete lack of communication from ACME Bharat was shocking. We stood in a queue for three hours just to get our baggage back. There was no one to guide us.

I had a business meeting in Bengaluru and booked a morning flight from Ranchi. ACME Bharat cancelled the flight and rescheduled me on an evening flight which was completely useless for me. I had to cancel the trip. Now they are refusing to refund, saying I accepted the alternative flight automatically. I did not accept anything!

Due to the sudden curfew restrictions in our city, we had to cancel our flight from Imphal to Guwahati. We have provided government notifications as proof of the lockdown, yet ACME Bharat is refusing a waiver on cancellation fees. We did not cancel by choice. Please show some flexibility in these tough times.

My flight from Dehradun to Delhi was cancelled at the very last moment. I had a connecting international flight to Dubai from Delhi on a separate ticket. Because of your cancellation, I missed my international flight and lost Rs 50,000. I am going to take ACME Bharat to the consumer court for this negligence.

I cancelled my ticket from Bhubaneswar to Varanasi due to personal reasons. While processing the cancellation on your website, the page crashed. Now my money is deducted, the ticket is cancelled, but I have not received any cancellation confirmation or refund receipt. Please check your buggy website and help.

Why does ACME Bharat cancel flights so frequently on the Delhi-Leh route? My flight was cancelled for three consecutive days citing weather, while other airlines flew successfully. Because of this, I was stuck in high altitude and fell severely ill. Your customer service is totally unresponsive.

I booked a round trip from Amritsar to Mumbai. The onward flight was cancelled by the airline, so I had to cancel my entire trip. But you have only refunded the onward journey amount and are charging me cancellation fees for the return journey. This is one single booking ID! Why should I pay for the return?

My flight from Visakhapatnam to Hyderabad was cancelled and I was promised a refund in the form of a travel voucher. I do not want a voucher because I do not plan to travel again anytime soon. I paid in cash/UPI and I want my money back in my bank account. Please do not force these vouchers on us.

Absolute chaos at Indore airport. ACME Bharat cancelled the flight to Delhi without giving any reason. The airline staff literally ran away from the counter when passengers started questioning them. No food, no water, no alternative arrangements, and total rudeness. This airline should lose its license.

My flight AB-302 from Bengaluru to Mumbai was delayed by three hours due to "operational reasons." Because of this, I missed my connection to Udaipur (AB-914) which was on the same ticket. Your airport staff at T2 Mumbai refused to help with hotel accommodation, saying no rooms were vacant, and I had to spend the night on a metal bench with my 65-year-old mother. This is absolutely inhumane service. I demand a full refund and compensation for this harassment.

I booked two separate tickets with ACME Bharat because your website showed a comfortable 2.5-hour gap at Delhi. My first flight from Patna was delayed by over two hours. When I landed at T3, I ran like crazy with my cabin luggage to T2, but your check-in counter for the Srinagar flight was already closed. Your ground staff was so rude and told me "different PNR means your responsibility." I had to pay an extra Rs 11,000 for the next flight. Extremely disappointed with this lack of empathy.

Worst experience with ACME Bharat Airlines yesterday. Flight from Kochi to Chennai got delayed and I missed my connecting flight to Coimbatore on the same PNR. The ground staff made me wait for 4 hours at the transit desk just to issue a new boarding pass for the next morning. No food vouchers were provided, and I had to buy expensive airport food for my kids. Is this how you treat your premium customers?

I missed my onward flight to Guwahati from Kolkata because your flight from Bagdogra was delayed. Both flights were on the same PNR booking. Your duty manager at Kolkata airport told me they would put me on another airline, but then they backtracked and forced me to wait 14 hours for the next ACME Bharat flight. My sister’s wedding functions have already started and I am stuck at the terminal. Please resolve this and pay for my mental agony.

I had booked Ranchi to Delhi and Delhi to Amritsar on two different PNRs with a 3-hour buffer. The Ranchi flight kept getting pushed back, first by 30 minutes, then 1 hour, then 2.5 hours. By the time we touched down in Delhi, my Amritsar flight had already departed. I understand it was a separate booking, but the delay was entirely your fault. At least waive the change fee so I can book the evening flight. Please reply urgently.

Writing this with deep frustration. My son was flying from Hyderabad to Pune via Bengaluru (Single PNR, AB-882 and AB-104). The first leg was delayed due to technical snags. He missed the connection at Bengaluru, and your staff did not even bother to inform him. He is a college student and was left stranded at the airport at midnight without any support. I had to book a private cab for him to reach Pune. This is highly unsafe and unprofessional.

Because of your flight delay from Ahmedabad, I missed my connecting flight from Mumbai to Goa. Even though it was on a single PNR, your transit desk team in Mumbai told me that they cannot do anything because the delay was due to "air traffic congestion." How is air traffic my fault? I have pre-booked hotel rooms in Goa worth Rs 25,000 which are now wasted for tonight. I need immediate reimbursement for this loss.

Absolutely pathetic service by ACME Bharat! Flight AB-405 from Bhubaneswar to Delhi was delayed, making me miss my connection to Leh (same PNR). Leh flights only operate in the morning, so now I am stuck in Delhi for 24 hours. Your staff refused to provide a hotel room, claiming Delhi hotels are full. They expect me to stay in the waiting lounge with my family in this heat. I want a refund of my entire ticket right now.

I had a business meeting in Lucknow and booked Chennai to Delhi and Delhi to Lucknow on two separate PNRs with ACME Bharat, keeping a 4-hour gap. Your Chennai flight got delayed by 4.5 hours because the incoming aircraft arrived late. Because of this, my entire trip is ruined and I missed my Lucknow flight. Your customer care is refusing any refund or free reschedule just because it was a different PNR. It was your operational delay!

My parents, both senior citizens, were travelling from Vijayawada to Dehradun via Delhi on a single PNR. The Vijayawada flight was delayed, and they missed the connection at Delhi. No wheelchair assistance was provided during the transit rush, and they had to walk all the way only to find the gate closed. They were made to sit at the Delhi gate for 6 hours without any food or water. This is disgusting service. I am going to file a case in consumer court.

I missed my connecting flight from Mumbai to Jaipur because the first leg from Goa was delayed. Since both were on the same PNR, your staff rebooked me on a flight for the next day. However, they refused to give me my checked-in baggage, saying it is already system-checked for tomorrow. I am transit-stuck without my clothes, medicines, and basic amenities. This is a complete nightmare. Please deliver my bags to my hotel.

My flight from Jaipur to Mumbai was delayed by two hours, and I missed my connection to Mangaluru. Both tickets were booked together on the same PNR. When I asked for a refund or alternative flight, your Mumbai counter staff started arguing with me and blamed the weather, even though other airlines were departing on time. I had to buy a fresh ticket on another airline for Rs 9,500 to reach home for an emergency. I want my money back.

I missed my connecting flight to Indore at Delhi T3 because my incoming flight from Raipur was delayed by almost three hours. Since I booked these as separate PNRs to save costs, your staff is completely ignoring my requests. But the Raipur delay was due to your crew arriving late, not weather! Why should the customer suffer financially for your internal management issues? I demand a waiver of the cancellation charges.

This is to bring to your notice the harassment I faced at Kolkata airport today. My flight AB-711 from Siliguri was delayed, and I missed my connecting flight AB-203 to Port Blair (same PNR). Instead of automatically booking me on the next flight, your staff told me that the next flight is fully booked for three days and I should go back home. This is ridiculous! I have a vacation planned. Sort this out immediately and book me on another carrier.

Extremely poor management by ACME Bharat Airlines. My flight from Nagpur to Pune via Bengaluru (same PNR) was disrupted because the Nagpur flight was delayed. I missed the connection at Bengaluru. Your staff at the transit desk was extremely rude, practically shouting at passengers who were asking for updates. They finally gave us a hotel, but it was a dirty lodge 15 km away from the airport. I feel insulted and cheated.

I booked Lucknow to Delhi and Delhi to Srinagar on two different PNRs with a 3.5-hour gap. The Lucknow flight was delayed by over 3 hours due to some technical issues at the gate. I missed my Srinagar flight. Your Delhi counter staff said they can’t do anything because of the different PNRs. Why should I pay Rs 12,000 extra for your technical failures? Your airline delayed me, you must bear the cost of the new ticket.

My daughter was flying from Vizag to Chandigarh via Delhi on a single PNR. The Vizag flight took off late and she missed her Delhi connection. She is only 19 and was travelling alone for the first time. Your staff did not assist her at Delhi airport and told her to manage her own food. She was crying on the phone for two hours before we could arrange a hotel for her. This is highly irresponsible behaviour towards solo female travelers.

My connection from Mumbai to Varanasi was missed because the flight from Udaipur was delayed by 90 minutes. Both flights were on the same PNR. Your staff at Mumbai airport told me that my bags would be automatically transferred, but when I finally reached Varanasi on a later flight, my bags were missing! Now I have missed my connection and lost my luggage too. What kind of premium airline is this?

I missed my connecting flight from Delhi to Jammu because my flight from Amritsar was delayed by your ground staff’s slow boarding process. Both legs were on the same PNR. I had to wait at the Delhi terminal for 9 hours for the next flight, and your staff did not even provide a bottle of water, saying "it is not in our policy for domestic delays under 10 hours." Absolutely pathetic and cheap service.

I had booked flights from Bhopal to Mumbai and Mumbai to Rajkot on two separate PNRs with a 3-hour layover. The Bhopal flight was delayed by 2.5 hours. I missed the Rajkot flight by just 10 minutes. Your Mumbai staff did not help at all, even though the delay was due to your own aircraft maintenance issues. I had to take a taxi all the way to Rajkot which cost me Rs 15,000. I need compensation for this massive inconvenience.

My morning flight AB-402 from Mumbai to Delhi was cancelled at the last minute. I have an urgent business meeting in Gurgaon today, but your counter staff is refusing to rebook me on the next flight to Noida or even Jaipur from where I can take a cab. This is extremely unprofessional, I need to reach the NCR region today itself.

I was booked on the Pune to Bangalore flight today, but due to a massive family emergency, I need to travel to Hyderabad instead. I am ready to pay the fare difference, but your app is not showing any option to change the destination city for today's flights. Please help me rebook this immediately as it is a matter of life and death.

Extremely disappointed with ACME Bharat. My flight from Kolkata to Guwahati got delayed by 5 hours, making me miss my sister's wedding functions. I requested your airport agent to rebook me on the next flight to Shillong instead so I could take a taxi and reach faster, but they flatly refused and behaved very rudely.

I am stuck at Chennai airport. My flight to Madurai was cancelled by you. I asked your staff to rebook me on the Coimbatore flight leaving in one hour so I can travel by road from there, but they are asking for a ridiculous change fee of Rs 6000. Why should I pay when the cancellation was from your side?

This is ridiculous. I had a ticket from Delhi to Patna today, but my meeting venue shifted to Ranchi last night. I tried calling your customer care helpline ten times to change my destination to Ranchi for today itself, but nobody is picking up the call. Is this how you treat your premium passengers?

My flight from Lucknow to Mumbai got cancelled. Instead of giving me a direct rebooking to Pune, which is my actual final destination anyway, your team is telling me to wait till tomorrow for a Mumbai flight. Please adjust my ticket for Pune today itself, both cities are close by and it solves my problem.

Severe issue with your booking system. I wanted to modify my Delhi-Ahmedabad flight today to Delhi-Vadodara due to a client emergency. Your website took the payment for the fare difference but the ticket was not issued, and now my original flight is also showing cancelled. Please resolve this and issue the Vadodara boarding pass.

I am currently at Cochin airport. My flight to Trivandrum got cancelled because of bad weather. I requested the check-in counter to rebook me on the Calicut flight instead so I can at least reach Kerala and manage, but they are saying they cannot change the sector. This is highly insensitive customer service.

My son is stuck at Bhubaneswar airport. His flight to Kolkata was cancelled. We want ACME Bharat to rebook him on the Ranchi flight today so we can pick him up from there by car. Your call center executives are completely useless and keeping us on hold for hours. Please take action immediately.

Worst experience with ACME Bharat Airlines today. My flight from Goa to Mumbai was delayed indefinitely. I requested a change to the Pune flight which was departing in 45 minutes, but the gate staff told me it is against policy to change the destination city. What kind of stupid policy is this during a delay?

I had a flight from Amritsar to Delhi today but due to heavy fog, it is delayed by 6 hours. I asked your ticketing desk to rebook me on the Chandigarh flight instead as it is operating normally and I can drive from there, but they are demanding Rs 7500 extra. This is sheer harassment of passengers.

Urgent request. I am booked on flight AB-102 from Hyderabad to Vizag today. Due to a sudden medical crisis in my family, I need to go to Vijayawada instead. Your customer care says change of sector is not allowed on the same day. Please make an exception, I am begging you. This is an absolute emergency.

Your ground staff at Jaipur airport has no manners. My flight to Ahmedabad was cancelled. I asked them to put me on the Indore flight today so I can manage my business from there, but they literally laughed at my request and told me to buy a new ticket. I want a full refund and compensation for this mental agony.

I missed my flight from Bangalore to Mangalore because of the terrible traffic block near the airport. I reached the counter 5 minutes late. I requested the staff to rebook me on the Coimbatore flight today as I can take a bus from there, but they are treating me like a criminal and refusing to help.

My flight from Patna to Delhi got cancelled. I have an international flight from Delhi tonight. Please rebook me on your flight to Jaipur or Chandigarh immediately so I can take a taxi and reach Delhi airport on time. Do not ruin my international trip, please coordinate fast.

Absolutely pathetic service. Booked Mumbai to Raipur today, but need to urgently go to Nagpur instead due to some unavoidable circumstances. Your portal is showing an error when I try to change the city. I am ready to pay the charges, please process this rebooking manually before the flight departs.

My flight from Srinagar to Jammu was cancelled today. Your agents are not giving any proper answers. Please rebook me on the flight to Amritsar instead, from there I will manage by road. I cannot sit at Srinagar airport with my elderly parents all night. Please help us.

I am trying to change my travel plan from Delhi-Lucknow to Delhi-Kanpur for today. The flight is in 3 hours. Your mobile app keeps crashing at the payment page and the customer care number is busy. If I miss this travel opportunity, ACME Bharat will be fully responsible for my business loss.

Why is it so difficult to get a simple sector change? I am at Chandigarh airport, my flight to Srinagar is delayed. I want to go to Jammu instead on your afternoon flight. The executive at the counter is saying it is not possible because it is a different city. Both are in the same state, please use some common sense.

My flight from Vijayawada to Bangalore was cancelled by ACME Bharat. I have a very important interview in Bangalore tomorrow morning. Please rebook me on your flight to Chennai today, I will take the Shatabdi train from there. Do not cancel my ticket without giving me this alternative.

I booked a fully refundable ticket from Mumbai to Bengaluru (PNR: J78YTR) because my meetings are always tentative. I cancelled it 5 days before the departure. It has been 25 days now and your customer care is telling me "refund is processed from our end". If it is processed, where is my money? Rs 12,500 is not a small amount to block like this. Pathetic service from ACME Bharat.

My flight from Srinagar to Delhi was cancelled by your airline due to operational reasons. I did not ask for a cancellation! Why am I being forced to accept a one-year validity travel voucher instead of a full cash refund to my credit card? I have no plans to travel again soon. This is a direct violation of DGCA guidelines. I want my money back immediately.

Absolutely disgusting behavior by the ground staff at Pune airport. My flight to Nagpur was cancelled at the last minute. They promised a full refund on the spot but now your system has only refunded the taxes (Rs 800) and deducted the entire base fare as a cancellation fee! Are you people running an airline or a scam? I want my full Rs 6,500 returned.

I paid extra for a refundable fare from Kochi to Chennai because of my mother's health condition. When I cancelled, your website charged me a Rs 3000 convenience and cancellation fee anyway. What is the point of buying a "refundable" ticket if you still cut half the money under different names? I feel completely cheated by ACME Bharat.

My Delhi to Guwahati flight was rescheduled by 7 hours. I could not take it as I had a family emergency to attend. I cancelled the ticket online, but your portal has automatically issued a credit shell voucher instead of back-to-bank refund. I do not want your useless vouchers. Convert this voucher into a bank refund to my HDFC account right now.

I booked a round trip from Kolkata to Port Blair for my family. Due to a medical emergency, we could not travel. I understand it was a non-refundable ticket, but surely you can refund the government taxes and passenger service fees? Your customer care is refusing to refund even a single rupee of the tax amount. This is illegal.

My flight from Hyderabad to Goa was cancelled on 12th October. It has been more than a month. Every time I call your helpline, they put me on hold for 20 minutes and then the call drops. I am tired of explaining my story to a new agent every day. Please refund my Rs 18,900. I am a senior citizen and this stress is affecting my health.

My Ahmedabad to Jaipur flight got delayed by 5 hours, so I missed the wedding I was supposed to attend. I refused to board the flight and asked for a refund. Now your team says since the flight eventually took off, I am marked as a 'no-show' and not eligible for a refund. This is ridiculous! Who waits 5 hours at the terminal?

I bought tickets for a family of four from Lucknow to Mumbai. The flight was cancelled by ACME Bharat. We were offered an alternative flight 24 hours later, which we declined. Your team promised a full refund within 7 working days. It has been three weeks and I have only received a partial refund for two passengers. Where is the rest of the money?

While booking on your app for Patna to Delhi, the payment got deducted from my GPay twice due to a technical glitch on your payment gateway. I only got one ticket. I have been chasing your chat support for the last 15 days for the second transaction refund of Rs 5,400. They keep asking for bank statements which I have sent thrice already.

I booked a non-refundable ticket from Bengaluru to Coimbatore. I had to cancel it because of the sudden lockdown restrictions. I am not asking for cash, just give me a credit note or voucher so I can use it later. Your policy is so rigid and anti-customer. Show some empathy during these difficult times instead of pocketing poor passengers' money.

Your agent at the Amritsar airport counter assured me that if I cancel my ticket there, I would get a cash refund because the flight was delayed by over 4 hours. It has been two weeks and nothing has arrived in my account. When I call customer support, they say there is no record of any refund request. This is absolute harassment.

I am extremely disappointed with ACME Bharat. My Bhubaneswar to Delhi flight was cancelled. Instead of refunding my money, you booked me on another flight with a 6-hour layover in Kolkata without my consent. When I demanded a refund for this inconvenient itinerary, your executive disconnected the call. I want a full refund immediately.

I had to cancel my leisure trip from Mumbai to Udaipur. I accepted a promotional voucher from your website as refund. Now when I am trying to redeem this voucher for my next travel, your system says it cannot be applied on weekends and festive dates! This was never mentioned in the terms. You have locked my Rs 9,000 in a useless piece of paper.

I had a connecting flight from Chennai to Dehradun via Delhi. The first leg was delayed, making me miss the second leg. ACME Bharat staff in Delhi told me they can only refund the Delhi-Dehradun portion, that too partially. Why should I pay for the first leg when I could not reach my final destination due to your own delay? I need a full refund.

My booking reference is QY67TR. I cancelled my Ranchi to Delhi flight well within the 24-hour grace window of booking, which makes me eligible for a free cancellation as per rules. Yet, ACME Bharat deducted Rs 3,500 as "cancellation charges". Please rectify this technical error and credit the deducted amount back to my Google Pay.

Your mobile app crashed while I was booking a flight from Goa to Mumbai. The money was debited from my bank but no PNR was generated. I had to book another ticket at double the price because it was urgent. Your customer service says they cannot find the transaction. I have the bank chargeback proof. Please process my refund of Rs 6,200.

I booked a business class ticket from Delhi to Bengaluru which was cancelled. I was downgraded to economy class on the next flight. The airline staff promised they would refund the price difference between business and economy class. It has been a month and no refund has been processed. Why are you sitting on my hard-earned money?

Extremely poor customer service. I cancelled my flight from Indore to Raipur ten days ago. Your portal shows "Refund Successful" but the money has not hit my bank account. My bank says no such refund has been initiated by the merchant. You are lying to your customers to buy time. Give me my money back or I will file a case in consumer court.

I booked a ticket from Varanasi to Mumbai for my aged parents. Due to health issues, they could not travel, so we cancelled 3 days prior. Your system only refunded Rs 450 out of Rs 11,000 paid. This is daylight robbery. Even for non-refundable tickets, the fuel surcharge and taxes should be returned. Please look into this immediately.

I flew from Mumbai to Bengaluru on flight AB-342 yesterday and my main check-in suitcase is completely missing. It had my laptop charger and expensive silk sarees for my sister's wedding tomorrow. Your ground staff at KIA airport had no answers and just told me to file a PIR. I need my bag delivered to my hotel immediately, this is extremely stressful!

Worst experience with ACME Bharat Airlines on my flight from Delhi to Patna. When I received my trolley bag at Patna airport, one of the wheels was completely broken and there was a huge crack on the side. It was a brand new American Tourister bag. The staff at the counter refused to take my complaint and blamed it on "wear and tear". I want compensation for this damage.

My flight from Kolkata to Guwahati got delayed by three hours, and to make things worse, my golf kit which was checked in as oversize baggage did not arrive at all. I am here for an amateur tournament starting tomorrow morning. How can you lose such a large and clearly marked item? Your customer service helpline is constantly busy. Extremely unprofessional.

Absolutely pathetic service! Flew Cochin to Chennai on 12th Oct. My check-in luggage was completely wet when it arrived on the conveyor belt. All my clothes, books, and gifts are ruined because of water damage. It seems you left the bags out in the heavy rain during loading. Who is going to pay for my ruined expensive clothes?

I travelled from Pune to Lucknow via Delhi. After waiting for two hours at Lucknow airport, I was told my bags were left behind in Delhi. Why should I suffer for your operational inefficiency? I have an important corporate meeting today and I don't even have a change of clothes or my formal shoes. Please trace my bag urgently and send it to my hotel.

Please help me. My elderly parents were travelling from Dehradun to Mumbai on flight AB-108. They had one oversized orthopedic mattress box which was paid for in advance. At Mumbai airport, they were made to wait for 1.5 hours near the belt only to be told the box is still in Dehradun. They are very old and this mental harassment is unacceptable.

My bag was checked in at Hyderabad for Ahmedabad. When I opened it at my home, I found that the zipper was broken and some expensive perfumes and a watch worth Rs 15,000 were missing from inside. It is clear that someone from your baggage handling staff stole my belongings. I am going to file a police complaint if this is not resolved.

What kind of service is this? Flew from Srinagar to Jammu today and my suitcase has arrived with the handle completely ripped off. I had to literally drag it on the floor of the airport. Your executive at Jammu airport told me to write an email and offered no immediate assistance. I expect ACME Bharat to pay for the repairs.

I took flight AB-501 from Goa to Mumbai. I checked in a carton containing delicate handicrafts and paid extra charges for fragile handling. Despite the "fragile" stickers, the box was completely crushed and torn from the side. The clay items inside are broken into pieces. Your ground crew handles luggage like garbage. I need a full refund for my damaged goods.

Extremely disappointed with ACME Bharat. I flew from Chandigarh to Jaipur with a layover in Delhi. My bags did not make it to Jaipur. Your staff says it is still in Delhi and will come by tomorrow’s flight. I have a family function tonight and all our traditional outfits are in those bags. This has completely ruined our family celebrations.

My son was travelling from Bhubaneswar to Delhi. He is a student and was carrying his study materials and certificates in his checked bag. It has been 4 days and his bag is still untraceable. Every time we call customer care, they say "we are looking into it". This is highly irresponsible behaviour from ACME Bharat Airlines.

I checked in my oversized bicycle box on my flight from Bagdogra to Kolkata. I paid Rs 3000 extra for this. When I collected it, the cardboard box was completely torn and the bicycle frame has deep scratches and a bent derailleur. This is a professional racing bike worth lakhs. Your staff is highly careless. I want a supervisor to call me immediately.

Terrible experience on flight AB-702 from Ranchi to Delhi. My brand new VIP trolley bag was completely soiled with black grease all over it and the lock mechanism was damaged. It looks like it was dragged on the tarmac. Why do you charge such high fares if you cannot even handle a passenger's personal bag safely?

My flight from Varanasi to Mumbai was delayed by four hours, and upon arrival, my bags were nowhere to be found. The ground staff at Mumbai airport made us stand in a queue for another hour just to fill the property irregularity report. I am extremely tired and frustrated. Please update me on where my bags are right now.

I am writing this with great anger. Yesterday I travelled from Amritsar to Bengaluru. One of my bags is missing. It contains my regular medicines for diabetes and blood pressure. I told this to your counter staff in Bengaluru, but they showed absolutely no empathy or urgency. If my health deteriorates, ACME Bharat Airlines will be fully responsible.

We took a flight from Nagpur to Pune last night. Our baby's stroller, which was checked in at the boarding gate, was delivered to us in a broken condition. The front wheel is completely bent and it is impossible to push it now. How are we supposed to travel with a toddler without a stroller? This is highly frustrating and unacceptable.

I flew from Indore to Visakhapatnam yesterday. My bag did not arrive on the belt. Today morning I got a call saying my bag has been found but I have to come to the airport to collect it myself. Why should I spend my time and money on petrol to rectify your mistake? You must home-deliver my bag as per DGCA guidelines.

My luggage was lost on flight AB-884 from Coimbatore to Chennai on Friday. I have sent three emails to your customer support team with my baggage tag details but have received only automated replies. There is no human response on your helpline either. This is the worst customer service I have ever experienced.

I checked in a large musical keyboard in an oversized hard case on my flight from Delhi to Kochi. Despite paying the extra baggage fee and securing it properly, the hard case has a massive crack and the keyboard inside is not turning on. It seems to have suffered a heavy impact. I need compensation for the repairs of my instrument.

Our family travelled from Madurai to Chennai on ACME Bharat flight AB-215. Two out of our three bags were missing at Chennai airport. We were told they would be sent to our home by evening, but it has been 24 hours and we have received nothing. No one is picking up the contact number provided on the PIR form. Absolutely ridiculous service!

Booked seat 12A on the flight from Mumbai to Delhi specifically because of my claustrophobia, but your ground staff arbitrarily moved me to a middle seat 22B just before boarding. The gate agent was extremely rude and said "it is an operational requirement." I paid extra for that seat. I want my money back and an apology.

I am travelling with my 75-year-old mother from Bangalore to Kolkata who has severe knee issues. We booked and paid for front row seats with extra legroom months in advance. Today at the airport, we were downgraded to the last row because your crew wanted to accommodate some VIP. She was in pain throughout the flight. Pathetic service by ACME Bharat.

What is the point of booking your Premium Economy ticket from Hyderabad to Chennai if you are going to downgrade us to basic Economy at the last minute and offer zero refund? The counter staff told me to "raise a ticket online" for the refund. This is highway robbery. Either refund the difference immediately or I am going to consumer court.

My husband and I were traveling from Kochi to Mumbai for our honeymoon. We paid extra to sit together. Why did your check-in system separate us and put me in 8B and him in 29E? The cabin crew refused to help us swap with anyone, saying the flight was full. We spent our entire flight apart despite paying your stupid seat selection fees.

Absolutely disgusted by the behavior of the ACME Bharat crew on flight AB-402 from Pune to Ahmedabad. I had explicitly requested a seat change to the aisle due to a medical condition, but they refused to help me, saying the flight is closed. Meanwhile, I saw them happily moving a young couple to extra legroom seats for free. Complete partiality and bias!

I paid for a business class upgrade at the Patna airport counter for my flight to Delhi. But after boarding, they told me the seat's recline function was broken and it was stuck in a completely upright position. I paid Rs 12,000 extra for this luxury? This is a complete scam, please refund my upgrade amount immediately.

Dear ACME Bharat, yesterday on my flight from Guwahati to Imphal, I was downgraded from my pre-booked emergency exit row seat to a normal seat because your crew said I did not meet safety criteria. I am a perfectly fit 35-year-old engineer. This is just an excuse because you gave my seat to one of your staff members who was traveling. Give me my refund.

I had booked seat 4C for my flight from Goa to Bangalore because of my height. At the boarding gate, they snatched my boarding pass and printed a new one with 27E. No explanation was given. The air hostess on board was so dismissive when I complained. Extremely unprofessional behavior, never flying with this airline again.

This is regarding the booking for my family of four from Delhi to Srinagar. We had paid for seat selection to sit together as we have small kids. On boarding, we found other passengers sitting in our seats who claimed the gate staff changed their seats. We had to sit separately and my 5-year-old daughter was crying the whole flight. Worst experience ever.

I was downgraded from Premium Economy to Economy on my flight from Amritsar to Delhi without any prior email or SMS. I only found out when the self-service kiosk printed my boarding pass. The airport manager, Mr. Sharma, was incredibly unhelpful and told me to send an email to customer care. I want my money back for the upgrade now.

My pregnant wife was traveling alone from Lucknow to Mumbai. I paid extra for an aisle seat near the washroom for her comfort. Your ground staff changed her seat to a window seat in the middle of the aircraft. She had to constantly disturb others to use the restroom. Your staff has zero empathy for pregnant women.

I booked an upgrade to Business Class using my hard-earned privilege miles for the flight from Kolkata to Jaipur. At the gate, they told me the aircraft was swapped and there is no Business Class on this new plane. They put me in Economy but my miles have still not been refunded to my account. Please reverse this immediately.

I had selected seat 14A for my window view on the flight from Dehradun to Delhi. When I boarded, I realized 14A has no window at all, just a blank wall! Your website seat map did not mention this. I paid extra for a window seat, not a claustrophobic wall. This is cheating the customers. I demand a full refund for the seat fee.

My father is a diabetic and needs constant access to the aisle. We booked an aisle seat for his flight from Ranchi to Delhi. But during web check-in, your system automatically changed his seat to a middle seat and is now asking for Rs 350 to change it back to an aisle. Why should we pay twice for your system's error?

While traveling from Coimbatore to Chennai, I was downgraded because the flight was overbooked. Your staff literally forced me to take an economy seat and promised that the refund for my business class ticket would be processed in 3 working days. It has been 15 days now and I have heard nothing. Please look into this.

I paid Rs 900 extra for seat 3F on flight AB-882 from Delhi to Varanasi. At the airport, they said the seat was blocked for some maintenance and moved me to 28B. When I went inside the flight, I saw someone else sitting on 3F! Why did your staff lie to me? Was that person a relative of your staff? This is highly corrupt behavior.

We had booked wheelchair assistance and a front row seat for my disabled uncle traveling from Vijayawada to Bangalore. Not only was the wheelchair delayed, but his seat was also changed to row 18 which is very difficult for him to access. The cabin crew did not even help him walk down the aisle. Shame on ACME Bharat Airlines.

I tried upgrading my seat from Lucknow to Delhi online. The transaction failed, but Rs 4500 was deducted from my bank account. My seat was not upgraded and I had to fly in my original seat. I have been calling your customer service for three days but they keep putting me on hold. Refund my money immediately.

Why does your airline treat domestic passengers like cattle? I paid for a seat change to an extra legroom seat on my flight from Port Blair to Chennai. Upon boarding, I found the seat pocket was completely broken and there was garbage left in it. When I asked for a seat change, the crew told me to adjust. This is what I paid extra for?

On my flight from Nagpur to Pune, I was downgraded to a standard seat from my preferred seat 2C. I am a frequent flyer with ACME Bharat, but the way your gate staff handled this was shocking. They literally told me "take it or leave the flight" when I questioned the downgrade. I will make sure my company terminates its corporate tie-up with you.

My 78-year-old mother was travelling alone from Varanasi to Mumbai. We booked a wheelchair assistance service well in advance and even reconfirmed at the check-in counter. But when the flight landed at T2, there was no one with a wheelchair. She had to walk the entire long aerobridge and corridor with severe knee pain. This is complete harassment of senior citizens. I want a strict explanation and refund of the priority charges.

I am currently 28 weeks pregnant and was flying from Delhi to Bengaluru yesterday. I had my doctor's fit-to-fly certificate, but your ground staff at IGI Airport gate behaved so rudely. They made me stand in the queue for 45 minutes, questioning the certificate authenticity as if I was lying. I got extremely dizzy and dehydrated. Absolute lack of basic empathy and training for handling pregnant passengers.

We booked the Unaccompanied Minor service for our 11-year-old son flying from Kolkata to Guwahati. Your staff literally left him alone near the boarding gate to go buy coffee. Another passenger noticed him crying and helped him. This is an extreme safety breach. If you cannot take responsibility of a child, why do you charge Rs 3000 extra for this service? I am going to file an official complaint with DGCA.

I booked wheelchair assistance for my father on flight AB-302 from Chennai to Port Blair because he recently underwent hip surgery. After landing, your staff brought a broken wheelchair with no footrests. My father's leg was dragging on the ground and he got injured. When we complained, the ground supervisor told us to adjust or wait for another hour. Pathetic service!

Extremely disappointed with ACME Bharat. I am a diabetic patient and was travelling from Hyderabad to Delhi. I had informed the crew that I needed to take my insulin injection with my meal at a specific time. The flight was delayed on the tarmac for two hours, and the crew refused to give me my pre-booked meal or even some sugar water, saying "service starts only after takeoff". My sugar levels dropped dangerously. You guys almost killed me.

My sister who is visually impaired was travelling from Pune to Jaipur. We were assured that your staff would assist her from the entry gate till her seat. Instead, the assistant left her near the security check area saying "someone else will come" and vanished. She was stranded there helplessly for 30 minutes in the crowd. This is how you treat specially-abled passengers? Shame on you ACME Bharat.

I had a major leg fracture and was travelling from Kochi to Mumbai. I paid extra for front row legroom seats and wheelchair assistance. While boarding, the crew told me my seat was changed to the middle row because of some aircraft change. How can a person with a straight plaster cast sit in a cramped middle seat? I had to travel in extreme agony for two hours. No compassion at all from the cabin crew.

My pregnant wife was travelling from Ahmedabad to Lucknow. She requested a simple glass of warm water to take her medicines, but the air hostess told her to wait until the trolley service started. Even after requesting three times, they ignored her. Is a cup of water so expensive for your airline that you cannot show basic humanity to a pregnant lady? Very disappointed.

We sent our 9-year-old daughter from Patna to Delhi under the UM package. We were told we would get SMS updates at every step. We received zero updates. We were panicking at Delhi airport for two hours not knowing if she even boarded the flight. When she finally arrived, she was crying because nobody escorted her to the washroom when she requested. Highly irresponsible behavior.

I am an asthma patient and was carrying my portable oxygen concentrator on my flight from Srinagar to Jammu. I had submitted all medical forms 48 hours prior. Yet, the boarding staff stopped me and argued for 20 minutes saying it is not allowed. I missed my boarding because of their sheer ignorance and lack of internal communication. I want a full refund and compensation for mental agony.

Very bad experience at Amritsar airport. My grandfather is 85 and cannot walk. We requested a wheelchair, but your staff said all wheelchairs are busy and we have to wait for 45 minutes. The flight boarding had already started. We had no option but to make him walk, which caused him severe breathing issues. Why do you accept wheelchair requests online if you don't have enough inventory?

I was flying from Ranchi to Delhi yesterday. I am currently in my 7th month of pregnancy and was carrying a small handbag. The security gate staff refused to let me board first, even though your policy says pregnant women get priority boarding. I had to push through a frantic, unruly crowd which was highly unsafe for my baby. ACME Bharat has the worst ground management.

My blind uncle was travelling from Bangalore to Coimbatore. The staff who escorted him to the seat did not even brief him about the safety features or where the call button was. When he wanted to use the washroom, he kept pressing the call button but no crew came for 20 minutes. He had to ask a co-passenger for help. This is a total failure of basic cabin service.

I paid Rs 4000 extra for the Unaccompanied Minor service for my nephew flying from Lucknow to Kolkata. On arrival, the ground staff handed him over to a random person without even checking their ID card or matching it with the authorization form we submitted. This is a massive security lapse! Anyone could have kidnapped the child. I am taking this to social media.

I am highly disgusted by the service of ACME Bharat Airlines. My mother who has severe arthritis was flying from Bhubaneswar to Delhi. The wheelchair assistant at Bhubaneswar was constantly complaining that she is too heavy to push and was demanding a tip. This is outright extortion and harassment of elderly passengers. Please take strict action against that staff member.

I had a medical emergency and had to fly from Goa to Mumbai post-surgery. I had a doctor's letter requesting a bulkhead seat. Your ticketing counter staff at Goa airport was extremely rude and said "if you want special seats, pay Rs 1500 extra, otherwise take the last row". I had no option but to pay under pressure. You people are looting passengers during their medical crises.

My wife is 32 weeks pregnant and we took a flight from Nagpur to Pune. We had booked seat 2C for easy access to the lavatory. At the gate, they forcibly shifted us to 28E saying the trim sheet had changed. A pregnant woman in a middle seat at the very back of the plane is a nightmare. The flight was bumpy and she threw up multiple times. Absolutely zero empathy from your staff.

I booked wheelchair assistance for my father from Bagdogra to Delhi. When we landed in Delhi, they made us wait inside the empty aircraft for 40 minutes after all passengers left, saying the wheelchair lift was busy. My father is a diabetic and his lunch time was passing. The crew was rushing us to leave because they wanted to clean the plane. Truly horrible experience.

My 12-year-old son was travelling alone from Chandigarh to Bengaluru. His flight was diverted to Chennai due to bad weather. Your airline did not bother to inform us about the diversion or his safety. We had to call the customer care 10 times to get any info. The child was stuck at Chennai airport for 5 hours without any food or supervision. This is highly negligent and traumatic.

I took a flight from Dehradun to Delhi today. I am currently recovering from a spinal injury and had requested assistance. The helper who brought the wheelchair was pushing it so fast and recklessly on the ramps that I felt severe jerks in my back. When I asked him to slow down, he started arguing and left me midway near the baggage belt. Worst staff behavior ever.

I flew from Mumbai to Bengaluru last week on ACME Bharat, and my Jodhpuri class loyalty points have still not been credited to my Club Bharat account. I have entered my boarding pass details thrice on your website, but it keeps showing an error. Please credit my 1200 points immediately.

Highly disappointed with ACME Bharat. I am just 150 Tier Points away from upgrading to Gold status, and my recent flight from Delhi to Patna has not been registered. My tier status is expiring this month-end, and if I lose my chance because of your system glitch, I will stop flying with you.

I have been trying to reach your customer care regarding my expired points. Because of the lockdowns and personal health issues, I could not travel from Pune to Delhi last year. You should have given an extension on the points expiry. Hard-earned miles cannot just disappear like this.

Absolutely pathetic service. I booked a flight from Chennai to Kolkata specifically because ACME Bharat was offering 2x bonus points. Now your backend team is saying that promo was not applicable for my fare class. This was nowhere written in the terms. Cheap tactics to fool customers!

Why is your website so slow and buggy? I am trying to claim missing miles for my flight from Kochi to Mumbai. Every time I upload the ticket copy, the page crashes. I have tried three different browsers. This is very frustrating for a frequent flyer.

I had a flight from Guwahati to Delhi on 12th October. I gave my Club Bharat frequent flyer number at the check-in counter, but the agent forgot to enter it. Now I am trying to claim it online and it says "passenger name mismatch". How is that possible? Please resolve this.

I am a Platinum member of ACME Bharat, but I was denied lounge access at Ahmedabad airport today. The receptionist said my tier status is showing as expired in their system, even though my app clearly shows validity till December. This was so embarrassing in front of my business clients.

I had 15,000 points which were supposed to expire next month. To save them, I tried to redeem them for a Delhi to Amritsar ticket, but your portal kept failing at the payment gateway for taxes. Now the points have expired and your team is refusing to reinstate them. Unfair business practice!

My family and I flew from Hyderabad to Goa last month. Only my husband's points got credited, but for me and my daughter, it shows "failed" under claim missing points section. We travelled on the exact same booking reference. Please fix this error and credit our miles.

I was promised a tier upgrade to Silver after completing 10 flights in a calendar year. I finished my 10th flight from Lucknow to Delhi on Sunday, but my profile still shows Bronze. I have a flight tomorrow and I need my priority baggage benefit. Kindly update this on priority.

Extremely angry with your loyalty program. I transferred 20,000 credit card points to ACME Bharat miles for a flight from Srinagar to Mumbai. The bank says transfer is successful, but your app shows zero balance. The flight seats are filling fast and I am losing my booking. Help!

I am trying to claim missing miles for a flight from Jaipur to Bengaluru that I took 5 months ago. Your system says claims can only be made within 90 days. But your own app was down for two months! Why should the customer suffer for your technical incompetence?

Your loyalty customer care helpline is useless. I spent 45 minutes on hold trying to ask why my tier points from my Indore to Delhi flight were credited as regular points instead of tier points. The agent had no clue and hung up on me. Is this how you treat loyal flyers?

I booked a flight from Bhubaneswar to Chennai for my father using my Club Bharat miles. At the airport, he was told his ticket was not issued properly and had to buy a fresh ticket at the counter for Rs 9,000. Why did you deduct my miles if the ticket was not confirmed? I want a full refund.

I have been a loyal customer of ACME Bharat for five years, flying weekly between Chandigarh and Bengaluru. Yet, my tier upgrade to Gold is stuck for the last three weeks. I have sent five emails to the loyalty desk but only get automated replies. This is sheer neglect of premium customers.

My Club Bharat account has been locked for no reason. I cannot log in to book my flight from Ranchi to Delhi using my points. I called customer care and they asked me to mail my Aadhaar card, which I did four days ago. Still no response. I am missing out on low fares.

This is regarding my flight from Nagpur to Mumbai on 5th September. I upgraded my seat using 5000 miles, but at the boarding gate, I was downgraded back to economy because of an aircraft change. Your staff promised my miles would be refunded in 48 hours. It has been three weeks now.

Why is there a discrepancy in points calculation? For my flight from Visakhapatnam to Bengaluru, I received only 300 points, whereas my colleague who flew on the same flight and same fare class got 600 points. Please explain this logic and correct my points balance.

I am highly frustrated with the ACME Bharat loyalty program portal. I am trying to merge my old mobile number account with my new one to consolidate my miles for a family trip to Bagdogra. The OTP never arrives on my registered email. Please do this manually from your end.

I have accumulated over 50,000 miles on ACME Bharat, mostly flying the Mumbai-Delhi sector. Now when I want to redeem them, your system shows "zero award seats available" for the next three months on every single date. What is the use of this loyalty program if we can never use the points?

Tried booking a ticket from Bengaluru to Mumbai today on your app. Transaction failed but Rs 6,500 got debited from my HDFC bank account. No ticket was generated and customer care is not picking up. Please refund my money immediately.

Extremely poor experience with ACME Bharat. I was booking flights for my parents from Delhi to Patna. The website crashed during payment, so I tried again. Now I see two charges of Rs 11,200 on my credit card, but I have received only one PNR. This is a clear double charge. Reverse the extra transaction ASAP.

My flight booking from Pune to Delhi failed at the payment gateway, but the money has left my account. It has been 48 hours and I have not received any confirmation or refund. I had to book another ticket via another airline by paying double the price. Very unprofessional.

I am trying to reach your helpline since morning. While booking Kolkata to Guwahati flight, your portal showed payment failed. But Google Pay shows successful transfer of Rs 4500 to ACME Bharat. I need my ticket or my money back right now, this is urgent.

This is ridiculous! I got charged twice for the same seat selection on my flight from Chennai to Coimbatore. Your system showed payment timeout the first time, so I paid again. Now both charges are reflecting in my bank statement. Kindly initiate the refund.

I tried booking tickets for a family of four from Kochi to Mumbai. The website showed payment error, but Rs 24,000 has been deducted from my SBI debit card. I don't have enough balance now to make another booking and my travel is day after tomorrow. Please resolve this on priority.

Worst booking experience ever with ACME Bharat. While booking Lucknow to Delhi flight, the app froze on the payment page. Money got deducted but your system says booking failed. Now I am stuck without a ticket and my money is also gone. Please check and reply.

My credit card has been charged twice for booking flight AB-402 from Hyderabad to Bengaluru. I received two different payment confirmation SMS from my bank but only one e-ticket. Please refund the duplicate amount of Rs 5,800 immediately.

I am extremely frustrated with your payment gateway. I was booking a flight from Jaipur to Ahmedabad. The transaction got cancelled midway, but the money was debited. Your customer support is telling me to wait for 7 days. This is my hard earned money, I cannot wait!

Why is your website so buggy? I paid Rs 7,200 for a flight from Amritsar to Delhi, the amount was cut from my UPI but your page showed 'Session Expired'. No PNR has been generated. This is cheating the customers. Please refund my money.

Two times money deducted for one single ticket from Bhubaneswar to Kolkata. First time your app said transaction declined so I used another card. Now both cards are charged. This is a technical glitch on your end, please refund Rs 3,900 back to my Axis bank card.

I booked a flight from Nagpur to Pune today. The payment went through, money got deducted, but the screen went blank. I have not received any SMS or email confirmation. How am I supposed to travel tomorrow? Please look into this urgent issue.

Your booking system is a total scam. I tried booking a ticket from Delhi to Srinagar. The payment failed three times but my credit card was charged for all three attempts! I have lost nearly Rs 20,000 in minutes. I want my refund instantly.

I am writing this with immense frustration. My transaction for Indore to Mumbai flight failed but Rs 5,200 got deducted from my GPay. I had to book again on another airline. Please return my money, I am a student and cannot afford to lose this amount.

ACME Bharat has the worst payment system. Attempted to book Goa to Mumbai flight. The transaction failed at the OTP stage, yet the money got debited from my account. Your customer care executive is giving scripted answers. I want my money back.

Double charged for baggage fee on my flight from Ranchi to Delhi. I paid online during web check-in but your counter staff said payment was not showing and forced me to pay again at the airport. This is double charging and total harassment. Refund my money.

I made a booking from Guwahati to Kolkata and the page redirected to an error screen. Money is debited from my account but no ticket has been issued. I need to travel for a medical emergency. Please process the refund or issue the ticket immediately.

Highly disappointed with ACME Bharat Airlines. My payment of Rs 8,500 for Patna to Bengaluru flight was debited twice due to your server crash. I have sent emails with screenshots but no one is replying. Please resolve this double charge issue.

Your mobile app is totally useless. It showed transaction failed twice while booking Chandigarh to Mumbai, but my bank account shows both transactions are successful. Rs 13,000 has been deducted from my account for nothing. Please refund immediately.

I was booking a flight from Visakhapatnam to Hyderabad. The payment gateway crashed after I entered the OTP. Rs 4,200 has been cut from my account. I have not received any booking ID. Please help me get my refund as soon as possible.

Worst experience with ACME Bharat at Mumbai T2. The boarding gate staff, some guy named Amit, was extremely rude when I asked about the delay for the Bengaluru flight. When I asked to speak to his supervisor, he literally laughed and told me to do whatever I want. Is this how you treat paying passengers?

I am writing this from Kolkata airport. The ground staff here is absolutely pathetic. They refused to accept my hand baggage which was well within the limits and started shouting at my elderly mother. When we demanded to see the duty manager, they kept telling us he is on break. I need a formal apology and action against this staff.

Extremely unprofessional behavior by the cabin crew on flight AB-402 from Delhi to Pune today. The air hostess literally rolled her eyes when I asked for water for my child. When I complained to the lead purser, she took her colleague's side instead of resolving the issue. I want a call from a senior customer service manager immediately.

I faced absolute harassment at the Chennai check-in counter today. The executive was so arrogant and refused to listen to my query about seat selection. When I requested him to call his supervisor, he flatly refused and told me to stand in another long line. I have never faced such cheap service in any domestic airline in India.

My flight from Hyderabad to Kochi was delayed by 3 hours and there was no communication. When passengers gathered to ask questions, the ACME staff at the gate started yelling at us to keep quiet. When we asked for the station manager, they threatened to call security on us. This is high-handedness of the worst kind!

The level of service on your Guwahati to Delhi flight yesterday was disgusting. The cabin crew ignored my call button three times. When I finally walked up to the galley to ask for tea, they were busy chatting on their phones and told me to go back to my seat rudely. I want to speak to a customer care supervisor about this lack of basic training.

The ground staff at Amritsar airport needs to be taught basic manners. They misbehaved with my wife over a minor cabin baggage weight issue (it was just 200 grams extra). When I asked to escalate the matter to their supervisor, they hid their name tags. This is highly suspicious and unprofessional. Please investigate.

I had a terrible experience at Ahmedabad airport with ACME Bharat. The check-in agent was incredibly slow and when I pointed out that the flight was boarding in 15 minutes, he started talking to me in a very threatening tone. I asked for the duty supervisor but was told no one was available. I missed my flight because of his attitude!

Highly disappointed with the service on AB-112 from Goa to Mumbai. The crew was extremely cold and rude. When I requested a blanket for my senior citizen father who was shivering, they said they don't have any in a very dismissive way. When I insisted, the supervisor came and spoke to me as if she was doing me a favor. Pathetic.

The staff at Lucknow airport boarding gate today was so disrespectful. They were talking in local slang and making fun of passengers who couldn't speak English properly. When I objected and asked for the station head, they ignored me completely and closed the gate. I will take this to social media if I don't get a response.

My flight from Patna to Delhi was delayed and when I asked the counter staff for the promised food coupon, she threw the booklet at me. What kind of training do you give to your employees? I demanded to see her supervisor right then, but they kept dilly-dallying for an hour until boarding started. Absolute cowards.

I want to file a formal complaint against the duty manager at Jaipur airport today. He was extremely condescending when we complained about the lack of wheelchair assistance for my grandfather. He told us "if you cannot walk, why do you travel?" I am absolutely shocked by this insensitivity. I want strict action taken.

The flight attendants on the Srinagar to Jammu flight were so hostile. They served snacks to everyone except my row and when I pointed it out, the crew member said "we ran out, adjust." No apology, nothing. Even the supervisor who came later was defensive and rude. I want a full refund for this mental agony.

Absolutely disgusting service at Bagdogra airport today by ACME Bharat team. They lost my stroller and when I asked for help, the lady at the counter told me it is not her job to look for it.
